experiment: Connected current-document wiki walk with explicit Back and visible/evidence stopping

protocol.next_window: First four distinct unvisited CURRENT outgoing destinations in recorded order; later local links retained; explicit history BACK charged as action.
protocol.named_stop: Unambiguous visible title or display_name equals supplied goal_name; no gold-ID stopping.
protocol.question_stop: Same Laya ARRIVED/CONTINUE decision on current body for all traversal policies; evaluation labels only used afterwards.
protocol.native_goal_selection: Three unique technical titles selected before inference; reverse topology distances3-4, starts2-16 outgoing destinations, different starts, no full breadcrumb supplied as goal.
protocol.public_selection: Five manually selected positives plus disconnected and absent controls; small dependent sample, not randomized.
protocol.network: HF offline plus macOS deny network sandbox

native.note: Captured local Native Notion containment, breadcrumbs, collection rows/templates and body hyperlinks. Private titles/IDs/URLs/traces omitted; no private Confluence publication.

public-confluence.initial_cache: Exact-state cache seeded from public-local; costs are incremental, not independent cold costs.

verification.lsp: TypeScript LSP not installed; user previously declined. Syntax checks and tests used.

confluence_replay.surface: Fresh HTTP GET replay of frozen successful public Laya route; original source hrefs resolve through registered Confluence copies. Inference was offline on verified snapshots, not online per-hop inference.

limitations: Ten handpicked cases; dependent public project questions and three local Native goals; no general success-rate claim.
Named goals stop by visible names. Question goals share the same uncalibrated local Laya stop decision across all traversal policies.
Full graphs are loaded for indexing, but actor sees current body paragraphs and current outgoing metadata only; unique body reads are logical access, not HTTP.
Four-option recorded-order windows and twelve-read budget can hide promising later neighbors until Back.
Public Confluence inference uses verified snapshots; fresh read-only successful-route replay is separate from online per-hop inference.
Private content publication remains unresolved. No paid LLM answer/judge or end-to-end paid-token-saving test.
Cached CLI reruns still load the model; wall times include startup. Cold/incremental observations are not a controlled speed benchmark.
